title: The Walking Dead: Dead City
syn: Maggie and Negan find themselves in different circumstances, wrestling with their purposes.

title: Hiding from the Dark
syn: Hiding from the Dark is a horror-themed middle grade novel written by Kiersten White that will be published by Random House on September 1, 2026.
syn_fr: Hiding from the Dark est un roman jeunes adultes d'horreur écrit par Kiersten White. Il sera publié le premier septembre 2026 par Disney–Lucasfilm Press aux États-Unis. Il sera adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis.

title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
syn: A space trickster traps the Enterprise crew in a soap opera as Pike mourns a lost life.

title: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5
syn: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5 is the upcoming fifth issue of the 2026 comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders. The issue will be written by George Mann, illustrated by Vincenzo Riccardi, Jagdish Kumar, and Michael Atiyeh, and published by Dark Horse Comics on September 9, 2026.
syn_fr: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 5 est le cinquième numéro de la mini-série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders écrit par George Mann dans le cadre du projet multimédia Star Wars : La Haute République.

title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
syn: Enterprise is commandeered by Admiral Reeger to track down an alien ship.

title: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss
syn: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss is an upcoming canon novel and the second entry of the Star Wars: Reign of the Empire trilogy written by Rebecca Roanhorse and set to be published by Random House Worlds on September 15, 2026. An audiobook version is set to be released along side the novel. It will be set in 6 BBY, one year before the first season of Star Wars: Andor.
wiki: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss
syn_fr: Reign of the Empire: Edge of the Abyss est un roman écrit par Rebecca Roanhorse. Il est le deuxième roman de la trilogie Star Wars : Le Règne de l'Empire. Il sera publié le 15 septembre 2026 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis. Il fut adapté en livre audio aux États-Unis. En France, il sera publié par Pocket en 2027.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2 is the second issue of the upcoming 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on September 16, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 2 est le deuxième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
syn: We return to the Elysian Kingdom, but this time on a real fantasy planet.

title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
syn: A time ripple damages the Enterprise, forcing young and old Uhura to cooperate and fix the timeline.

title: Get Jiro
syn: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

title: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty is the first entry in Star Wars: Smugglers and Scoundrels, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Originally announced for a September 13, 2026 release, it will be written by Cavan Scott and illustrated by Christian Colbert, and will be released on October 6.
wiki: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty
syn_fr: Smugglers and Scoundrels: The Race for Jabba's Bounty est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Cavan Scott.

title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
syn: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is an upcoming canon Star Wars racing video game developed by Fuse Games and published by Lucasfilm Games alongside Secret Mode. The game will be released for PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S on October 6, 2026.

title: Avatar: Seven Havens
syn: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

title: VisionQuest
syn: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

title: Rogue One - Chirrut & Baze 1
syn: Rogue One – Chirrut & Baze 1 is an upcoming canon one-shot comic focusing on Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe that will be published as part of a 2026 series of one-shots for the ten-year anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story.The issue will be written by Stephanie Phillips, illustrated by Sean Chen, Kieran McKeown, and Yen Nitro, and published by Marvel Comics on October 14, 2026.
syn_fr: Rogue One – Chirrut & Baze 1 est le quatrième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées one-shots Star Wars: Rogue One. Il est écrit par Marc Bernardin.

title: Hyperspace Stories: Mace
syn: Hyperspace Stories: Mace is a canceled graphic novel in the Star Wars: Hyperspace Stories series of graphic novels featuring a young Mace Windu. The issue was written by Justina Ireland, illustrated by Georges Duarte and PH Gomes, and was announced to be published by Dark Horse Comics.
syn_fr: Hyperspace Stories: Mace est un numéro one-shot de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars : Histoires de l'hyperespace écrit par Justina Ireland.

title: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6
syn: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6 is the upcoming sixth and final issue of the 2026 comic book series Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders. The issue will be written by George Mann, illustrated by Vincenzo Riccardi, and published by Dark Horse Comics on October 21, 2026.
syn_fr: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders 6 est le sixième et dernier numéro de la mini-série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The High Republic Adventures – Pathfinders écrit par George Mann dans le cadre du projet multimédia Star Wars : La Haute République.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 3
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 3 is the upcoming third issue of the 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on October 21, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 3 est le troisième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Clayface
syn: Follow the terrifying descent into hell of a promising Hollywood actor who has become a monster driven by revenge, exploring the loss of identity and humanity, the ravages of toxic love and the dark side of scientific ambition.
syn_fr: L'ascension fulgurante de Matt Hagen, de gamin des rues de Gotham à star hollywoodienne, est brutalement interrompue lorsqu'un baron du crime le laisse atrocement défiguré. Abandonné de tous et n'ayant plus rien à perdre, Matt se tourne vers un traitement expérimental qui lui rend miraculeusement son apparence... mais altère profondément sa perception de la réalité. Il sombre alors dans une spirale destructrice, consumé par un irrépressible désir de vengeance.

title: Rogue One - Darth Vader 1
syn: Rogue One – Darth Vader 1 is an upcoming canon one-shot comic focusing on Darth Vader that will be published as part of a 2026 series of one-shots for the ten-year anniversary of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story. The issue will be written by Chris Condon, illustrated by Luke Ross, and published by Marvel Comics on October 28, 2026.
syn_fr: Rogue One – Darth Vader 1 est le cinquième et dernier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées one-shots Star Wars: Rogue One. Il est écrit par Chris Condon.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4 is the upcoming fourth issue of the 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on November 18, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 4 est le quatrième numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5
syn: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5 is the fifth and final issue of the upcoming 2026 canon comic book miniseries Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren set between the events of The Last Jedi and The Rise of Skywalker. The issue will be written by Charles Soule, illustrated by Will Sliney, and published by Marvel Comics on December 2, 2026.
syn_fr: The Fall of Kylo Ren 5 est le cinquième et dernier numéro de la série de bandes dessinées Star Wars: The Fall of Kylo Ren écrit par Charles Soule.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
syn: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.
syn_fr: Les Avengers, les Wakandais, les Quatre Fantastiques, les New Avengers et les X-Men, tous héros issus de trois univers distincts se retrouvent sur une trajectoire de collision mortelle et font face à une menace existentielle sans précédent, comme ils n'en ont jamais rencontré auparavant, le Docteur Doom.

title: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon is the first entry in Star Wars: Tales from the Outer Rim, a line of canon graphic novels published by Mad Cave Studios. Written by Greg Pak and illustrated by Brent Schoonover, it will be released on March 9, 2027.
wiki: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon
syn_fr: Tales from the Outer Rim: The Legend of Beggar's Canyon est une bande dessinée one-shot écrite par Greg Pak.

title: Twin Crossroads
syn: Twin Crossroads is an upcoming canon adult novel that takes place between the events of Episode VI: Return of the Jedi and Episode VII: The Force Awakens, and will be written by Beth Revis and published in hardcover by Random House Worlds on April 6, 2027. It was first listed on the Penguin Random House website on July 18, 2026 and was officially announced at the Random House Worlds panel at San D…
syn_fr: Twin Crossroads est un roman écrit par Beth Revis. Il sera publié le 6 avril 2027 par Random House Worlds aux États-Unis.

title: Star Wars: Starfighter
syn: Star Wars: Starfighter is a stand-alone live-action film currently in post-production at Lucasfilm with filmmaker Shawn Levy serving as the director and former Lucasfilm president Kathleen Kennedy producing the project. The film is set to take place around five years after the events of Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker, and may include some characters from the sequel trilogy. Ryan Gosli…
syn_fr: Star Wars: Starfighter est un film Star Wars dont la production a commencé en 2025, après plusieurs années de développement. Réalisé par Shawn Levy et produit par Shawn Levy et Kathleen Kennedy, l'histoire se déroulera environ cinq ans après les événements de Star Wars épisode IX : L'Ascension de Skywalker.

title: Spider-Man: Beyond the Spider-Verse
syn: Hunted by Miguel O'Hara's Spider Society and betrayed by his friends, Miles finds himself in the darkest corners of the Spider-Verse in search of a way home. Knowing that his family has been not only fractured but endangered by his calling, it's a race against the clock for Miles to travel across the wildest reaches of time and space to fight for and reunite everything he holds most dear.

title: Man of Tomorrow
syn: Superman and Lex Luthor find themselves forced to work together—to a certain degree—against a much, much bigger threat when Brainiac sets his sights on Earth.

title: Avengers: Secret Wars
syn: An upcoming film in Phase Six of the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU) and the finale of The Multiverse Saga.
syn_fr: Adaptation de Secret Wars de Jim Shooter et un prochain film de la phase 6 du Marvel Cinematic Universe qui conclura la saga du multivers.

title: The Batman: Part II
syn: Sequel to the 2022 film The Batman.
syn_fr: La suite du film The Batman de 2022.
